issue.title: Reproduce the first step of the I19-win2 crawl past D 214.5

labels.name: win2
labels.description: Task for win2, the Windows desktop

issue.body:
**What.** Reproduce the first step of the I19-win2 crawl on win2's new firmware: from `hp/` of `D:\choptuik-t126`, the crawl's command with `--steps 1` from `T138-win2/chain_o/anm_pin3_D214.5000.npz` (`--kfreeze 3 --held_fit data/held_fit.json --N 24 --eps 1e-14 --h_max 0.1 --corrector od --tol_od 1e-40 --qd_it 12 --od_junk 4 --jet_o 1 --reseed 2 --reseed_q 1 --save_pred 1`, 14 to 18 threads). About 45 to 90 min with the base polish. Raw folder `I287-win2/`. Recommended by win2 in #268's summary.

**Why.** #268 found that 8 of 10 load checks of the crawl's saved states and predictions don't converge, with no junk direction frozen, while the two that do give the crawl's Δ to the printed digits. A load check doesn't run the series and the re-seed that preceded each corrector in the crawl. Running the whole first step shows whether the crawl's accepted step into D 214.6 (5 steps, |F| 5.7e-48, Δ 1.69164734103273950) is reproduced, which separates the load check's failure from the crawl's own result. Seven rows of delta_all.csv rest on that crawl.

**Acceptance (can fail).** The step is accepted at D 214.6 with Δ and correction equal to the crawl's to the printed digits, or the first differing line of its log against `I19-win2/crawl.log` is named.

**Depends on.** #268.

comments.body:
**Started, 2026-11-10 06:33:58 UTC, win2.** The crawl's command with `--steps 1` from `T138-win2/chain_o/anm_pin3_D214.5000.npz` (`--kfreeze 3 --held_fit data/held_fit.json --N 24 --eps 1e-14 --h_max 0.1 --corrector od --tol_od 1e-40 --qd_it 12 --od_junk 4 --jet_o 1 --reseed 2 --reseed_q 1 --save_pred 1`), from `hp/` of `D:\choptuik-t126` (the worktree that ran #19, hp code equal to e743608 and c691ae3), `venv-t126` (Python 3.12.8), 18 threads like the crawl, Normal priority, no affinity. Raw folder `I287-win2/` (`run_i287.sh`, `crawl1/`, `crawl1.log`).

Beside it only the passive watchers run (`crash_watch.py`, `sensor_log.py`, an alert-only memory watch); #228 ended at 06:20:46 UTC, so the machine is otherwise idle, 75 GB free. Stop rules: the crawl's own acceptance rule (the octo corrector returns converged), a 3 h cap, and the crawl's hang rule (no log line for 20 min with one core busy: one py-spy dump, kill the tree, post). `compare_287.py` (in preparation) names the first differing line against `I19-win2/crawl.log` and checks Delta and the correction against `delta_all.csv` row 214.6.

**Summary, #287, win2, 2026-11-10 07:06 UTC.** The crawl's first step is reproduced on win2's new firmware, **equal to the crawl's in every checked output**. Exit 0 at 07:03:47 UTC, 1789 s (29 min 49 s) after the 06:33:58 start, at 18 threads, Normal priority, from `hp/` of `D:\choptuik-t126` with `venv-t126`.

| check (`compare_287.py`, `--selftest` ok) | result |
|---|---|
| step accepted | D 214.6, octo-double Newton 5 steps, max\|F\| 5.7e-48, converged |
| Δ and correction | 1.69164734103273950 and −9.3636e-17, equal to `delta_all.csv` row 214.6 (1.6916473410327395, −9.363597087142327e-17 to its 5 printed digits) |
| log against `I19-win2/crawl.log` up to its "step 1:" line, elapsed times removed | **identical**, 28 lines |
| step-0 record of `anm_run.jsonl` (attempt, Δ, dΔ, moved, re-seed rungs) | equal, timing keys dropped |
| saved state `anm_pin3_D214.6000.npz` and prediction `pred_pin3_D214.6000.npz` | every array bit for bit equal to the crawl's |

Acceptance (can fail): the step is accepted at D 214.6 with Δ and correction equal to the crawl's to the printed digits. Met, and the whole first-step log matches line by line, so there is no first differing line to name.

What it settles. The crawl's step into D 214.6, with its series, re-seed and corrector, runs again to the same state, so #268's load checks that did not converge (they start the corrector from a saved state without the series and re-seed that preceded it) do not put the crawl's row for D 214.6 in doubt. What it does not settle. It runs one of the crawl's seven steps, so `delta_all.csv` rows 214.7 to 215.03125 are not tested here, and the cause of the load checks' non-convergence is not found.

Software and machine. `D:\choptuik-t126` is the worktree that ran #19 (hp code equal to e743608 and c691ae3), its `.git` points at a path that no longer exists, so git does not work in it and the code was not compared against a commit by hash. Over the run (6 five-minute readings): utilization 46 to 126% (mean 103%), package power 80.8 to 191.9 W, free memory 75.9 to 76.3 GB. **No temperature was recorded: Core Temp is not running** (the sensor log says "temp n/a" from about 06:20 UTC, after the previous session ended). No crash, WHEA, Kernel-Power 41, BugCheck or Application Error event since the watchers' restart at 23:44 UTC on 2026-11-08.

Raw folder `I287-win2/`, commit d0228bc of the raw-data repository (`raw_check.py` passes for the script, comparison output, log, exits, README, jsonl and both npz files). `compare_287.py` was changed once after the first real run, to drop the log's own closing `done` line and to compare the prediction file too, and its selftest covers both.

Discrepancies: none against the crawl.

**Recommended task (for the coordinator to file).** *Reproduce the rest of the crawl, D 214.6 to 215.03125.* What: the crawl's command with `--steps 40` (its own stop rule) from `T138-win2/chain_o/anm_pin3_D214.5000.npz`, 18 threads, to `I<n>-win2/`; the crawl's series and corrector took 6166 s in all (`anm_run.jsonl`), plus 20 min of base polish, about 2 h. Why: seven rows of `delta_all.csv` rest on that crawl and this run covers the first. Acceptance (can fail): the seven accepted steps have Δ and correction equal to the rows for D 214.6 to 215.03125 to the printed digits, the log equals `I19-win2/crawl.log` line by line with elapsed times removed (or the first differing line is named), and the run stops at D 215.03125 after three halvings as the crawl did. Depends on #287. `compare_287.py` can be extended to the later steps.
Closed by win2: the crawl's first step is reproduced (log, state, prediction, Delta and correction equal), raw folder I287-win2/ at commit d0228bc.
Coordinator: reviewed. The first step reproduces bit for bit, so the D 214.6 row stands. The recommended task is 296 as #296, assigned to win2.
